family_fixing.template_reselection: structural, from code review, before any TRAIN measurement
family_fixing.statement: The eight new families were fixed from published economic priors before any v2 measurement. Fix round 1 re-selected templates structurally from an independent code review (split handling, market-return coverage, overlap with v1 momentum/low-risk/size tilts), and fix round 2 hardened the ivol_change variance shares and recorded expected overlaps from a re-review, still before any TRAIN measurement; no IC, return, turnover or correlation output was consulted to choose or tune them. TRAIN fits only per-candidate signs; validation is not used for selection.

family_priors.prior: Intermediate return persistence, with the most recent month excluded.
Path efficiency, return-sign consistency and risk-scaled persistence; related variants share one family budget.
Smoothed contrarian intermediate returns and distance from a trailing mean.
Low volatility, downside variability and volatility expansion; factor preferences, not neutralized alpha.
Raw-dollar liquidity level, expansion and instability; no adjusted-price/share-volume dollar proxy.
Return/flow co-movement and signed dollar-flow balance, using actual shares times raw close.
Adjusted-close position within its own trailing range and slow moving-average structure; no candle fields.
252-session-year proxies only; not calendar seasonality or a claim of independent effects.
Blitz, Huij and Martens (2011, J. Empirical Finance) standardized residual momentum; Grundy and Martin (2001, RFS) factor-adjusted momentum.
Frazzini and Pedersen (2014, JFE) betting against beta; Bollerslev, Li, Patton and Quaedvlieg (2022, JFE) realized semibetas.
Ang, Hodrick, Xing and Zhang (2006, JF) idiosyncratic volatility; Fu (2009, JFE) expected vs unexpected idiosyncratic volatility; Durnev, Morck, Yeung and Zarowin (2003, JAR).
Bali, Cakici and Whitelaw (2011, JFE) MAX; Amaya, Christoffersen, Jacobs and Vasquez (2015, JFE) realized skewness.
Gervais, Kaniel and Mingelgrin (2001, JF) high-volume return premium; Barber and Odean (2008, RFS) attention.
Amihud (2002, J. Financial Markets) unexpected illiquidity; Roll (1984, JF) implied spread; Pastor and Stambaugh (2003, JPE) volume-induced reversal.
Ang and Chen (2002, JFE) asymmetric correlations; Hou and Moskowitz (2005, RFS) price delay; Barberis, Shleifer and Wurgler (2005, JFE).
Baltussen, van Bekkum and van der Grient (2018, JFQA) vol-of-vol; Adrian and Rosenberg (2008, JF) short/long volatility components.

fields.name: close
fields.basis: f64(source float32 raw close) * vendor cumulReturnFactor; adjusted total-return proxy

fields.name: raw_close
fields.basis: unadjusted source float32 close widened to f64; USD/share

fields.name: volume
fields.basis: unadjusted source share volume widened to f64

fields.name: mkt_ret
fields.basis: equal-weight mean adjusted close-to-close return (close[d] / close[d-1] - 1) over the previous session's (d-1) as-of members, broadcast to every name present at d; produced upstream, not by the DSL

data.decision_support: as-of member AND present AND finite positive current close
data.vm_support: full historical as-of membership; temporal raw history retained
data.forward_support: strict source presence and positive finite endpoints; pair counts and missing fractions reported
data.market_return: mkt_ret panel field: equal-weight mean adjusted close-to-close return (close[d] / close[d-1] - 1) over the previous session's (d-1) as-of members, broadcast to every name present at d; produced upstream, not by the DSL
data.prior_bar_accounting: prior_bars charges mkt_ret one prior bar (d-1..d), the same as ret; native_prior_bars follows the native typecheck, which charges fields 0

orientation.inverse: multiply centered rank by frozen sign

composition.diversity: structural economic-family/template budgets; no statistical independence claim
composition.storage: one D*N blend plus one incoming candidate; orient then accumulate before discarding candidate (one VM pass)
